title: Where Locale Delivers: Every California City and ZIP Code
summary: Where does Locale deliver? Locale reaches 675 ZIP codes across six California regions, from all nine Bay Area counties to LA. Check your city here.
body_markdown:
## The California delivery footprint, defined


The footprint covers 675 residentially deliverable ZIP codes across 312 California cities, in six regions: the SF Bay Area, Greater Los Angeles, Orange County, the Sacramento Region, Monterey Bay and Santa Cruz, and the Northern San Joaquin Valley. Until now, that footprint has never been published anywhere on the site. This page is the complete list, gaps included, so you can check your address in one glance before you pick a plan.


## The six regions covered


Here is the footprint at city level, region by region. Every city named below sits inside a verified delivery ZIP


.


## All nine Bay Area counties, named


The Bay Area part of the footprint is complete at county level: all nine official counties are covered, namely San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, Solano and Sonoma. That includes the Peninsula, the Tri-Valley, the whole of Marin and Wine Country, alongside San Francisco, San Jose, Oakland, Berkeley and Santa Rosa.


## Cities by region: LA, Orange County, Sacramento


Region Cities and areas covered


SF Bay Area All nine counties: San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, Solano and Sonoma. Weight-carrying cities: San Francisco, San Jose, Oakland, Berkeley, Santa Rosa, Palo Alto, Redwood City, Sunnyvale, San Mateo, Fremont, Concord, Hayward, Walnut Creek, Richmond and Vallejo, plus the Peninsula, the Tri-Valley, all of Marin and Wine Country.


Greater Los Angeles Los Angeles, Long Beach, Santa Monica, Torrance, Inglewood, Glendale, Burbank, Culver City, Venice, Beverly Hills, the South Bay beaches and the Valley.


Orange County Irvine, Santa Ana, Anaheim, Garden Grove, Orange, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Costa Mesa and Fullerton.


Sacramento Region Sacramento, Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom, Davis, Citrus Heights, Rocklin, West Sacramento and Woodland.


Monterey Bay and Santa Cruz Santa Cruz, Capitola, Aptos, Scotts Valley, Monterey, Pacific Grove, Carmel, Salinas and Watsonville.


Northern San Joaquin Valley Stockton, Tracy, Lodi and Lathrop.


If you want the food itself rather than the map, we have written the region up in detail: our[Best Organic High-Protein Meal Delivery: SF Bay Area](https://www.shoplocale.com/blogs/comparisons/best-organic-high-protein-meal-delivery-sf-bay) comparison, the[Best High-Protein Meal Delivery in San Francisco and Los Angeles](https://www.shoplocale.com/blogs/high-protein/best-high-protein-meal-delivery-in-san-francisco-and-los-angeles) guide, and, for readers ordering for parents,[Bay Area Senior Meal Delivery: What to Check First](https://www.shoplocale.com/blogs/standards/bay-area-senior-meal-delivery-what-to-check-first) .


## Checking your own ZIP in under a minute


Most readers can stop at the table above. If your city spans several ZIPs, or you live near a regional boundary, confirm the specific code with the ZIP Code lookup tool on USPS.com[\[1\]](https://tools.usps.com/zip-code-lookup.htm) , which USPS points customers to for exactly this[\[2\]](https://faq.usps.com/s/article/ZIP-Code-The-Basics) . Worth knowing too: ZIP codes do not necessarily adhere to city or municipal boundaries, they are designed to reflect the post offices, delivery units and carrier routes that actually deliver to you[\[2\]](https://faq.usps.com/s/article/ZIP-Code-The-Basics) . Thirty seconds, and you know exactly what we know. When you are ready to order, you enter your ZIP directly at[delivery details](https://www.shoplocale.com/pages/delivery-info) , and the checkout confirms whether we reach you before you pay.


1. Find your city in the table above. If it is listed, you are in the footprint.
2. If your city has multiple ZIPs or sits near a boundary, look up your exact ZIP with the USPS tool.
3. Match your ZIP against the plan page at checkout. If it clears, pick your meals.


## Where Locale does not deliver yet


Naming the gaps matters as much as naming the coverage, so here is the no-list, plainly:


- San Diego County
- The Inland Empire: Riverside and San Bernardino
- Ventura and Santa Barbara, apart from the Westlake Village and Thousand Oaks edge
- The Central Valley south of Stockton: Modesto, Merced, Fresno, Bakersfield
- The North Coast and the far north of the state


One honesty test worth spelling out: Pasadena. Only one of its six ZIPs, 91103, sits inside our footprint, so the honest answer for a Pasadena reader is no. The same goes for the San Gabriel Valley generally. We would rather lose the order than ship a wrong coverage claim.


## Choosing a plan once your address clears


If your address cleared, the rest is simple. Delivery is weekly. The order cutoff is Thursday at 12pm, and a skipped week is not charged, so travel or a fridge full of leftovers never costs you anything


.


- Plan sizes are exactly 4, 6, 8, 10, 16 or 20 meals per week. Not a continuous range, so pick the size that matches your week.
- Each meal carries 40-60g of protein and 8g+ of fiber.
- We cook only with olive oil and avocado oil. No seed oils, no refined sugar, no processed ingredients.
- Meals arrive in reusable, microplastic-free glass jars that we pick up, sanitize and refill.


Those fiber numbers are worth a second look. WHO advises that everyone older than 10 consume at least 25 grams of naturally occurring dietary fibre a day[\[3\]](https://www.who.int/news/item/17-07-2023-who-updates-guidelines-on-fats-and-carbohydrates) , a figure it repeats in its healthy diet guidance[\[4\]](https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/healthy-diet) , so one meal covers roughly a third of it, with the protein to keep you full through a working day. Registered dietitians make the same point about getting those nutrients from whole foods rather than supplements[\[5\]](https://www.eatright.org/food/nutrition) . It is food built for the week you actually have, not the one you mean to get around to.


That is the whole decision: find your city above, then choose a 4 to 20 meal weekly plan on the[plan page](https://www.shoplocale.com/pages/select-plan) . Your fridge fills once a week, and lunch stops being a problem you solve daily.


## Frequently asked questions


Does Locale deliver to my address?


If you live in the SF Bay Area, Greater Los Angeles, Orange County, the Sacramento region, Monterey Bay and Santa Cruz, or the Northern San Joaquin Valley, most likely yes: Locale reaches 675 residentially deliverable ZIP codes across 312 California cities. Check the region and city lists above, or confirm your specific ZIP with the USPS lookup tool. If your city is not listed, Locale does not reach you yet.


What is the most reliable meal delivery service?


No third-party ranking or award covers Locale's delivery coverage, so treat any most-reliable claim with caution. What you can check yourself: a service that publishes its full footprint, states its order cutoff plainly, and does not charge for skipped weeks is showing reliability up front. Locale publishes all three: 675 ZIP codes across six regions, a Thursday 12pm weekly cutoff, and no charge for a skipped week.


Where can I find meal delivery services in Orange County?


Locale delivers across Orange County, including Irvine, Santa Ana, Anaheim, Garden Grove, Orange, Huntington Beach, Newport Beach, Costa Mesa and Fullerton. Orange County is one of Locale's six delivery regions, so if you live in any of those cities you can order a weekly plan directly.


Where can I find healthy food in Sacramento?


Locale delivers to the Sacramento region, including Sacramento, Elk Grove, Roseville, Folsom, Davis, Citrus Heights, Rocklin, West Sacramento and Woodland. Meals arrive weekly with 40-60g of protein and 8g+ of fiber each, cooked only with olive and avocado oil.


Where can I find healthy food in San Jose, California?


San Jose is inside Locale's delivery footprint. Santa Clara County is one of the nine official Bay Area counties Locale covers, alongside San Francisco, San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, Solano and Sonoma. San Jose residents can order a weekly plan of 4 to 20 meals.


Does Locale deliver to San Diego?


Not yet. San Diego County is outside Locale's delivery footprint, along with the Inland Empire (Riverside and San Bernardino), Ventura and Santa Barbara apart from the Westlake Village and Thousand Oaks edge, the Central Valley south of Stockton, and the North Coast and far north.


When do I need to order for the next delivery?


The weekly order cutoff is Thursday 12pm. Delivery is weekly, and a skipped week is not charged. Plan sizes are exactly 4, 6, 8, 10, 16 or 20 meals per week, not a continuous range, so pick the size that matches your week.
